## Services
- Urgent electrical problems: Water near the panel, a burning smell or a breaker that won't stay on. We get power off safely, check the circuits, tell you what happened and replace what's damaged.
- Panels, service & feeders: Breaker replacements, service risers and underground feeders, done neatly and to code.
- EV chargers & 240V outlets: 50 amp, 240 volt garage outlets for plug-in vehicles, and dryer or range circuits, including gas-to-electric conversions.
- Lighting, fans & bath combos: Recessed lights, attic and bath fans, and fan-light-heater combos, even in tight, low-ceiling spots.
- Outdoor kitchens & patios: Power, lighting and fans for outdoor kitchens and covered patios, so the grill and the ceiling fan both just work.
- Step & deck lighting: Low step lights set into stairs and decks, so the way down is lit and safe after dark.

## About
Reed Electric is a residential electrician based in North Austin, off Fleischer Dr in 78728. We work in houses, condos, garages and backyards across Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Wells Branch and Cedar Park. Most of what we do is the everyday work that keeps a home running: panels and breakers, 240V outlets for EV chargers and dryers, recessed lights, fans, outdoor kitchens and step lights. When something goes wrong, like water reaching a panel, we come out quickly, make it safe, and come back to replace what was damaged. Customers mention our crew by name, Stanley, Kyle, Randall and Maximus among them, and the same things come up again and again: we show up on time, take a real look before saying no, keep you updated before, during and after the job, and explain it all in simple terms.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you install an outlet for my EV charger?
  A: Yes. We install 50 amp, 240 volt outlets in garages for plug-in vehicle chargers. Tell us your charger and where you park and we'll quote it.
- Q: Can you convert my dryer from gas to electric?
  A: Yes. We run the 240V circuit and install the dryer outlet. If your panel or fuse box needs work to carry the new circuit, we'll tell you up front and handle it, and we keep you updated before, during and after the job.
- Q: Will you explain what's wrong before you start?
  A: Yes. Customers tell us that's what they value most: we explain what we found and what we'll do in simple terms, on the phone and on site, before any work starts.
- Q: Water got near my electrical panel. What should I do?
  A: Don't touch the panel or anything wet near it. If you can do it safely, keep away from the area and call us right away at (561) 919-3222. We'll shut power off safely and check the circuits.
- Q: Another electrician said it can't be done. Will you take a look?
  A: Yes. We'll check the attic, walls or crawl space ourselves and tell you honestly what's possible.
- Q: Do you work in condos and apartments?
  A: Yes. We work in condos as well as houses, including panel issues caused by leaks from neighboring units.
